anthrōpŏmorphītae , ārum, m., = ἀνθρωπομορφῖται,
I.heretics that attributed to God a human form, Aug. Haeres. ad Quod vult Deum.—Hence, anthrōpŏmor-phītĭcus , a, um, adj., professing the error of such heretics: “haeresis,” Isid. Orig. 8, 5 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
